# `scripts/citation_check.py`'s allowlist: a cited path that is deliberately not in the tree.
#
# One path per line. Every entry needs a stated reason above it. An entry that stops being
# necessary — because the file was written, or the citation corrected — should be removed; the gate
# does not yet detect a stale entry, which is a gap named in its own stage entry.

# Gitignored by design and must never be committed. `CLAUDE.md` rule 9 and ADR-035 §C3 make this
# file the local, never-committed real-data exceptions list; `scripts/real_data_exceptions.py`
# reads it when it is present and fails closed when it is not. Every citation of it is a citation
# of something that is correctly absent from this repository.
config/real_data_exceptions.yaml

# A gate that was **proposed and never built** — which this gate found, and which is worth keeping
# visible rather than silently correcting. Four records in the decision log and two plan entries
# cite it as the mechanism that would catch exactly the defect class `scripts/citation_check.py`
# now catches. Allowlisted so the gate is usable today; the right resolution is to decide whether
# `citation_check.py` *is* that gate under another name and amend those records, which is an
# owner-facing question rather than a rename.
scripts/doc_citations_check.py

docs/demo/2026-09-24/demo_up.sh
packages/schemas/_pending_port_placeholders.py
packages/schemas/_phase0_placeholders.py
